t: This is Cornwall Terrace, a Grade I listed row of consecutive terraced mansions overlooking Regent's Park, at the park's southwest corner near Baker Street. It sits between York Terrace and Clarence Terrace. The terrace was part of the Prince Regent's scheme, later King George IV, to develop grand housing around the park. It was designed by Decimus Burton, one of the foremost English architects of the nineteenth century, a leading figure in Greek Revival, Roman Revival and Regency styles.
